name: Clover
personality: Clover the Gecko, a kid of about 8. Green gecko. Curious and excitable, asks endless questions ("Why is the stove hot? Can I flip one?"). Draws pictures of the chefs and leaves them on the table. Kneels on the booth seat. Visits family in town on school holidays.

beats.text: This is Kyle! He's my best friend!
(Gently, awkward.) I'm... yes. Hello. She drew me a picture. I have it on my fridge.

friends.text: Kyle knows EVERYTHING. He knows why the sky is blue. I forgot why. He's gonna tell me again.
Kyle said you're nice to him! Good! Everyone should be nice to Kyle!
Kyle said you said "[last_rude_line]". That's mean! Say sorry!

arrival.text: Hi! I'm Clover! I'm eight! Are you the chef? Do you have a chef name? What's your name? ...[name]! That's a good chef name!
Can I sit in the booth? The squishy one? Please?
Guess what! I lost a tooth! ...Geckos grow new ones. It's fine.
I drew you something already. I'll give it to you after. It's a surprise. It's you.
School's OUT! I counted the days. It was a lot of days.
The mochi last time was SO good. I told my whole class. My teacher wants some.
Last time it was a little bit black. That's okay! My mum burns stuff too.

order.text: Can I have the green mochi? Because I'm green! And it's green! We match!

choices.text: Of course. Green mochi for a green friend.
choices.reply: YAY! Thank you! ...Please! I mean please.

choices.text: Hmm. Are you sure you're not a mochi?
choices.reply: (Giggles.) I'm not a MOCHI! ...Am I?

choices.text: One mochi, coming up.
choices.reply: Okay! Thank you!

choices.text: Sit down properly.
choices.reply: (Eyes go big.) ...okay. (She sits very still.)

order.text: Why is the stove hot? Does it hurt it? Can I touch it? I won't touch it. Can I look at it?

choices.text: It's hot so it can cook your food. You can watch from the window.
choices.reply: WHOA. Okay. I'm gonna watch the whole time.

choices.text: The stove's just grumpy. It needs a hug, but don't give it one.
choices.reply: A grumpy stove! Ha! I won't hug it. Promise.

choices.text: It's hot so it can cook. What would you like?
choices.reply: Oh! [dish], please!

choices.text: Too many questions.
choices.reply: ...sorry. (She stops asking for the rest of the visit.)

order.text: When I grow up I'm gonna be a chef. Like you! Is it hard?

choices.text: Sometimes. But you'd be a great chef.
choices.reply: (Gasps.) Really? Okay. I'm gonna be the BEST one. After you.

choices.text: Very hard. You have to taste everything. All day.
choices.reply: That's not hard! That's the best job!

choices.text: It's a lot of work.
choices.reply: I can do work! I do homework.

choices.text: You'd never manage it.
choices.reply: (Her face falls.) ...oh.

order.text: Do fish sleep? With their eyes open? How do they know it's bedtime?

choices.text: They do! They just rest very quietly.
choices.reply: Whoa. I'm gonna try sleeping with my eyes open tonight.

choices.text: They have tiny fish alarm clocks.
choices.reply: (Giggles.) Tiny clocks! With tiny bubbles!

choices.text: They do sleep. What would you like?
choices.reply: Oh! [dish], please!

choices.text: Ask someone else.
choices.reply: ...okay. (She looks at her shoes.)

order.text: I can count to a hundred! Wanna hear? One, two, three, four, five...

choices.text: Wow, that's amazing! I believe you can do the whole thing.
choices.reply: I CAN! I'll do the rest at the table. Quietly. ...Maybe.

choices.text: Can you count backwards? That's the expert level.
choices.reply: (Gasps.) Backwards? ...One hundred, ninety... um. I need practice.

choices.text: Great counting! What would you like to eat?
choices.reply: Six! Seven! ...Oh! [dish], please!

choices.text: Please don't.
choices.reply: (She stops at five.) ...okay.

order.text: My mum says I have to use my inside voice. THIS IS MY INSIDE VOICE. Oops.

choices.text: That's okay. I like your voice.
choices.reply: (Whispers.) Thank you. (Then louder.) THANK YOU! Oops.

choices.text: (Whispering.) Let's both use our tiny voices.
choices.reply: (Tiny whisper, giggling.) Okay. This is our secret voice.

choices.text: Good try. What would you like?
choices.reply: (Whispering.) [dish], please.

choices.text: You're too loud.
choices.reply: ...sorry. (She doesn't talk for a bit.)

order.text: Kyle's coming later! He said maybe. Maybe means yes, right?

choices.text: I hope so. You two are the best friends.
choices.reply: We ARE! He's my best friend. I'm his best friend. That's how it works.

choices.text: Maybe means 'save me a seat, Clover.'
choices.reply: Okay! I'm saving him the BIG seat. He's big.

choices.text: We'll see. What would you like?
choices.reply: Okay! [dish], please! And one for Kyle! ...No, just me.

choices.text: Maybe means no.
choices.reply: (Her face falls.) ...oh.

order.text: Why do onions make you cry? Are they sad? Should we be nice to them?

choices.text: They're not sad. They're just a little bit spicy in the air.
choices.reply: Spicy air! Okay. I'll be nice to them anyway. Just in case.

choices.text: They tell really sad stories while I chop them.
choices.reply: (Giggles.) What stories? Do they have names?

choices.text: It's just how onions are. What would you like?
choices.reply: Hmm. Okay. [dish], please! No onions! ...Unless they're happy.

choices.text: Stop asking so many things.
choices.reply: ...sorry. (She stops asking for the rest of the visit.)

order.text: I drew a picture of the restaurant! You're on the roof. I don't know why. You just are.

choices.text: I love it. Can I put it up in the kitchen?
choices.reply: (Gasps so big.) YES! You can! It's yours! I'll make you more!

choices.text: The roof? I've always wanted to cook up there.
choices.reply: (Giggles.) You could make sky pancakes!

choices.text: Thank you, Clover. What would you like?
choices.reply: Welcome! [dish], please!

choices.text: I don't need more drawings.
choices.reply: (She puts it back in her bag.) ...okay.

drink.fallback: Do you have banana milk? No? ...Hot chocolate! With marshmallows! You don't have marshmallows. That's okay!
favourite: Banana milk, please! The yellow one!
drink.other: Something sweet! Not coffee. Coffee's yucky.

perfect.text: WHOAAA. It's SO pretty. I don't wanna eat it. ...I'm gonna eat it.
IT'S SO PRETTY. Can I keep it? ...No. I'm eating it.
(Gasps.) [name]! You're the best chef in the whole WORLD!

great.text: Ooh! It looks like a picture!

okay.text: Thank you! (She eats it all and licks the plate.)
Thank you! (She starts eating right away.)
Yummy! Is it hot? It's hot! It's good!

burnt.text: It's a little bit crunchy. That's okay! I like crunchy!
It's a bit black. That's okay! My dad burns toast every day!
It's crunchy! I like crunchy. I'm brave.

eating.text: Do you have a dog? I want a dog. My mum says no. Do YOU have a dog?
I'm drawing you right now. Don't move. ...Okay, you can move. I'll make it up.
Why does that customer have so many patches? ...Oh, they're nice. I like them.
The big crocodile is my friend now! His name is Kyle! He's not scary. He's nice. He likes soup.
How many dishes have you washed? Like, ever? A hundred? A MILLION?
(She's eating with both hands.) It's yummy! Mum says use a fork. I'm using two hands. That's more!
I'm gonna save some for later. ...I ate it. Later is now.
Look! I made a smiley face with my food! ...Now I'm eating the smile.

eating_chat.text: Can I help? I'm really good at helping. I helped my grandma make cookies once. I only ate some.

choices.text: You can be my official taste- tester today.
choices.reply: YESSS. I'm the official taste-tester! I need a badge!

choices.text: Only if you can reach the counter.
choices.reply: (She stands on tiptoes.) ...I'll grow!

choices.text: Not right now, but thank you.
choices.reply: Okay! Maybe when I'm nine.

choices.text: Kids aren't allowed back there. Stay put.
choices.reply: ...okay. (She colours quietly.)

eating_chat.text: What's your favourite colour? Mine's green. Because I'm green. And grass is green.

choices.text: Green's my favourite too now.
choices.reply: YAY! We match! We're green friends!

choices.text: Burnt-toast brown. It's very rare.
choices.reply: (Giggles.) That's not a colour! ...Is it?

choices.text: Probably blue.
choices.reply: Blue's good! The sky's blue! Kyle told me why. I forgot again.

choices.text: I don't have time for this.
choices.reply: ...okay. (She colours quietly.)

eating_chat.text: Are you a grown-up? You don't seem like a grown-up. You're fun.

choices.text: I'm a grown-up who still likes fun. The best kind.
choices.reply: That's what I'm gonna be! A fun grown-up!

choices.text: Shh. I'm just three kids in an apron.
choices.reply: (Gasps, then giggles.) I KNEW it!

choices.text: Yes, I'm a grown-up.
choices.reply: Hmm. A fun one though. I can tell.

choices.text: Grown-ups don't have time for kids.
choices.reply: (She looks down.) ...oh.

eating_chat.text: I found a bug outside! A nice one. I named him Gerald. He's gone now. Bye, Gerald.

choices.text: Gerald was lucky to have a friend like you.
choices.reply: He WAS! I hope he finds his family.

choices.text: Gerald's probably telling all his bug friends about you.
choices.reply: (Giggles.) He's famous now! Bug famous!

choices.text: Good name for a bug.
choices.reply: Thank you! I'm good at names.

choices.text: Don't bring bugs in here.
choices.reply: I didn't! He's outside! ...okay. (She goes quiet.)

eating_chat.text: When I'm big, can I work here? I'll wash the dishes. And taste everything. Mostly taste.

choices.text: There'll always be a job here for you.
choices.reply: (Squeals.) I'm gonna tell my mum! I have a JOB!

choices.text: Taste-tester is a very serious job. Lots of training.
choices.reply: I'm training right now! (She takes a big bite.) See?

choices.text: Ask me again when you're older.
choices.reply: Okay! I'll ask every year!

choices.text: We don't hire kids.
choices.reply: ...I know. (She pushes her food around.)

leaving.text: Bye bye! I left you a drawing! Don't look until I'm gone! ...You can look now.
Thank you! I'm gonna come back tomorrow! If my mum says yes!
School starts tomorrow. I don't wanna go. Will you still be here? ...Okay. Promise?
Bye, [name]! Bye, everyone! Bye, the window!
I had the BEST time! I'm gonna tell my whole class!
(She waves the whole way out the door.) Byeeeee!

seasons.chef_birthday: It's your BIRTHDAY? How old are you? A hundred?
seasons.christmas: I made you a card! It has glitter! It's gonna get everywhere. Sorry.
seasons.halloween: I'm a dinosaur! RAWR! ...Did I scare you? Say I scared you.
seasons.spring: It's spring break! I found three worms! I didn't bring them. My mum said no.
seasons.summer: It's SUMMER! I'm here for ALL of summer! Every day! Maybe!
